# Why I Am Not a Christian

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1927*

A lecture given in 1927 before the National Secular Society, and the most widely circulated of his texts. Russell examines the classical proofs of God's existence one by one, then argues that religion feeds on fear, and fear is a bad counsellor. The title was later used for a collection of his essays on religion (1957).
